description: Repairs r-expr-1b/sandbox-array-functions: the Array() crash destroyed the other 28 results. Asks which array-valued functions the expression service admits and what an array result does at the DAO boundary, without the Array constructor (no statement here contains it): Split, Join, Filter, UBound and LBound over Split results, indexing in place, VarType/TypeName/CVar of an array, and IRR, NPV and MIRR over Split results. Each expression is its own snapshot. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
